title: 電気数学
subtitle: Mathematics for Electrical Engineers
courseType:
Mathematics and Science Program
Mathematics and Science Courses
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn the advanced mathematics which is considered necessary to understand specialized subjects in the field of electrical and electronic fields. Specifically, students will learn Fourier series, Fourier transform, and Laplace transform. These are necessary to understand the following subjects: "Transient Phenomena in Linear Circuits", "Electric Circuits IV for Electrical Engineering Course", "Feedback Control", "Power Electronics" and “ Transmission of Electronic Information”
advice: The following items are handled in the course: Introduction: What is Fourier analysis? Chapter 1 Fourier Series Chapter 2 Fourier Transform Chapter 3 Laplace Transform Chapter 4 Discrete Fourier Transform and Discrete Cosine Transform Chapter 5 Fast Fourier Transform Chapter 6 Fourier analysis and differential equations Chapter 7 Fourier Analysis and Linear Response Theory
books: We have not prepared English Textbook yet, but you can find a lot of English textbooks on this subject in book stores.
requiredKnowledge: The following knowledge is needed to study this course. - General mathematics learned in high school. - Sophisticated mathematics learned in “Integrated Math and Science for Engineering” and “Linear Algebra”

activityGoals.body: To understand the Fourier series and to solve basic calculations and application problems.
To understand the Fourier transform and to solve basic calculations and application problems.
To understand the Laplace transform and to solve basic calculations and application problems.
To understand the algorithms for discrete Fourier transforms on computers.
To solve the problems of differential equations using Fourier transform and/or Laplace transform.
